explication: FileSync is a browser-based, peer-to-peer file sharing application. A user opens a room URL, the web client initializes room membership and peer connections, signaling exchanges WebRTC setup messages, and the transfer engine streams selected files over encrypted data channels. Recipients choose a filesystem, service-worker, or Blob sink, with interruption recovery handled in the transfer layer. The API supplies short-lived TURN credentials, while signaling and optional TURN relay support connectivity. Excerpts were partial, so only evidenced wiring is shown.
